title: Read current joining progression without a retired waitlist cohort gate

source.ref: Daniel requested analytics flow blocks; root approved removing nonexistent waitlist/applicant markers after exactmain766068a audit.

detail: The acquisition journey registry still included waitlist.joined/application.submitted, which have no current emitters or taxonomy registrations. The existing journey_funnel SQL walks sequential same-identity cohorts, so that retired member step creates an empty actor cohort and forces later account and induction steps to zero. The current registry excludes that nonexistent transition, starts its member run at the real account.created marker, and reads sampled invitation reach from current /join entries instead of obsolete /beta paths. Existing journey key land_to_beta and anonymous-session versus member identity boundaries remain intact: the readout never infers a joined visitor-to-account conversion. Labels and notes explicitly describe sampled landing-path vitals, which cannot measure all visits or every later SPA navigation. No SQL or emitter behavior is changed, no private identity stitching or Google event is introduced, and no historical coverage is fabricated. The new actual registry-to-SQL-spec and read-model probe fails all three cases on untouched main766068a and passes after the change, checking no retired cohort seed, actual /join path specification and the explicit identity seam followed by measurable account-to-induction progression. Existing journey, insights reader and vitals tests remain unchanged and pass31 cases; the new three cases pass. Growth LIVE-2280 confirmed no overlap with its separate growth/user-flow sources. No onboarding files, providers, emails, schedules, SQL or production data are changed. Final verification passes34 focused tests across four files, including the unchanged existing journey/insights reader/vitals tests and the three new registry/spec cases. Three changed JavaScript/TypeScript files pass ESLint. These isolated tests verify code contracts, not production counts. Root source review passes; question and step label explicitly say sampled landing page loads rather than navigation reach. Required backlog passes2714 entries with1006 run probes agreeing. Independent registration-review peer passes the final registry/spec/read-model behavior, sampled landing-path wording and unlinked anonymous-to-actor boundary. The old existing tests/probes remain unchanged. Own new test SHA256 e3af23a32ccbfb8e76791ffb1969a4c52ce9af6d2e352d3c2db51eb93230f511; own probe SHA256 16b03e88f242536d11436c56129a0566ec658c65e13e2a1ff14fb2504bf15c93. This receipt does not claim production deployment or measured production counts.
